youtube.baslik: Can an audiometer's earphone be swapped for another model? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Each transducer connects to the audiometer through its own output, and the device uses separate calibration values for each. These values are specific to the transducer model; if an earphone is replaced with a different model, the levels delivered will be wrong and the audiometer must be recalibrated. Even a small fault in a transducer can make the whole audiogram misleading.
